vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module is a core utility for procedural terrain generation, responsible for creating tileable ground textures based on defined material types like grass, dirt, and rock. It utilizes noise functions from terrain-noise.ts to drive height fields and color mixing logic. The primary function, groundTexture, generates structured GroundTexture objects containing albedo (color/height) and normal maps (roughness) for rendering pipelines.
